items.title: Policy-based multi-model routing for governed workload distribution
exit_criteria: Routing policies are configurable and auditable

latest_evidence.result: Policy router supports ordered/least_loaded/weighted_load, health/capability/cooldown filtering and strict exact-route semantics; main gateway routing integration remains open.

items.title: Interactive Browser Behavior Lab for Discovery
exit_criteria: Hover/focus probes capture DOM/accessibility/network deltas

latest_evidence.result: Behavior Lab hover on .ds-toggle-button observed DeepThink before/after with unchanged pressed=false state; 4 network requests captured; 0 websocket/SSE; no click or prompt sent.
